lookup.heading: Find a place
lookup.lede: Shelters, AEDs, and hospitals first. If hours or an address is missing, it stays blank.
lookup.coverage: Mima City (JIS 36207), 515 rows. Tourism 116, cultural property 110, care 80, AED 72, shelters 45, emergency sites 40, hospitals 23, childcare 16, public Wi-Fi 9, public facilities 4. GTFS stops: 0, unpublished.
lookup.licenseNote: Licenses split by row. CC BY 4.0 follows Tokushima Our Open Data. A city-site listing is a fact from city.mima.lg.jp, not under that license.
lookup.mapGap: {n} places have no coordinates in the open data.
lookup.mapHonest: We don't guess. No OSM, no Google. Dots are pack lat/lon only.
lookup.mapCitePack: Points: 61 official coordinates from the frozen pack (accessed 2026-08-25).
lookup.mapCiteBbox: The frame is the bounding box of those 61 points. Real N03 shapes are not in git.
lookup.idleHint: Pick a chip or type a name. We don't dump 515 cards on first paint.
lookup.loadError: Couldn't load the list. Wait a moment, then tap a chip again.
lookup.empty: Nothing matches. Switch a chip or shorten the search.
lookup.tally: Counts by category (so a miss is visible)
lookup.unpublishedNote: This category is unpublished. We didn't invent rows.
